name: @me-mcp/orchestrator-mcp

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description:
IMPORTANT: This is your ONLY way to communicate with the human. The human cannot see your text output - they can only hear you through this tool.

Use this tool to:
- Ask questions and get answers
- Present options and get decisions
- Explain something when the human asks for clarification
- Respond to any human request or question

You MUST call this tool every time you need the human to hear or respond to something. Do NOT just write text assuming the human will see it.

question.description: The message to speak to the human (question, explanation, or response)

tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Log a decision you made during the task. Use this to record important choices and their reasoning for future reference.

tools.name: notify_done
tools.description: Notify that you have completed your work. For developers: use verdict "completed". For reviewers: use "approved" or "changes_requested".

summary.description: Summary of what was done or review feedback

tools.name: log_step
tools.description: Log a step in your work progress. Use this to track what you are currently doing. Call this when starting a new phase of work.

stepType.description: The type of step: planning, implementing, testing, reviewing, waiting, completed, or failed

title.description: Short title for this step (e.g., "Analyzing codebase", "Creating new component")

description.description: Optional longer description of what this step involves

tools.name: complete_step
tools.description: Mark the current step as completed. Use this when you finish a phase of work before moving to the next step.

stepId.description: The ID of the step to mark as completed

tools.name: set_working_directory
tools.description: Set the working directory for subsequent agents in this task. Use this after creating a git worktree or clone to tell the next agent where to work.

path.description: Absolute path to the working directory

project.description: Filter by project name (e.g. skillbotai, mei)

tools.name: experience_recall
tools.description: Context-aware retrieval for current task. Returns applicable (high confidence) and consider (medium confidence) experiences.

tools.name: propose_architecture
tools.description:
Propose an architecture document for the current task. Use this when you have gathered enough information through discussion and are ready to propose an implementation approach.

The architecture document should include:
- High-level approach
- Key technical decisions
- Files that will be modified or created
- Any constraints or considerations

After proposing, the human will review and either approve or request changes.

approach.description: High-level description of the implementation approach

decisions.description: Key technical decisions made during discussion (e.g., "Use Stripe for payments", "Store tokens in Redis")

filesToModify.description: Comma-separated list of files that will be created or modified

constraints.description: Any constraints, considerations, or trade-offs to be aware of
